Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Guest Faculty posts at CUTN?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Guest Faculty positions at Central University of Tamil Nadu is 28th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Guest Faculty positions?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies for the Guest Faculty positions at the Central University of Tamil Nadu.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Guest Faculty posts?
faq.answer: The educational qualification varies by post, but generally includes a Master's degree with a minimum of 55% marks in the relevant field, along with NET/Ph.D. Specific qualifications for English and Heritage Management posts are also detailed.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Guest Faculty positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all Guest Faculty positions at CUTN is 70 years.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for the CUTN Guest Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary structure for the Guest Faculty posts?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 500 per teaching hour, with a maximum monthly salary of Rs. 25,000 for most posts, and Rs. 15,000 for the English Language post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to apply via email for the Guest Faculty positions at CUTN.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Guest Faculty roles?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q9. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Guest Faculty positions at CUTN is scheduled for 29th September 2026.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for CUTN Guest Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF link is provided in the "Important Links" section of this article for your convenience.
